envelope.description: Use explicit verified private npm throughout source builds

body.title: Use explicit verified private npm throughout source builds
body.summary: Extend the existing canonical build stages with the approved explicit npmCli option and add the private source-build environment composition. Reuse runtime policy and coordinator ownership rather than introduce another build pipeline.
acceptanceChecks: Run npm ci and every coordinated stage through absolute verified Node 22.22.1 and matching npm 10.9.4 CLI, including when bin/npm is absent. Existing ordinary coordinator defaults remain unchanged.

Prepend private Node for child scripts, clear Node injection and inherited foreign coordinator identity, pin native runtime/header settings and fail concretely on missing verified prerequisites without host/elevated fallback.
Preserve explicit CUDA-install values including empty; default skip only when absent. Preserve delegated Git/registry credentials without capturing them or changing global config, HOME or PATH.
Resolve accepted-checkout helpers/dev dependencies from that checkout; any necessary packaging root/npm override stays minimal and retains the existing writer, fingerprint and native-probe gates.
